# Public SiteOne fixture

Source: [docs/OUTPUT-crawler.siteone.io.json](https://github.com/janreges/siteone-crawler/blob/f3d967b190a77ff5f816b7ddab74c1a778d9dbaf/docs/OUTPUT-crawler.siteone.io.json), revision `f3d967b190a77ff5f816b7ddab74c1a778d9dbaf`.

Original export SHA-256: `7bac8a509d59d3ad365bad4636e5d41c6752ee323460c2cd9de1bfcfed3b24b1`, 290507 bytes. The repository declares MIT, copyright 2023-2026 Ján Regeš. The adjacent LICENSE retains the original license text.

`public-export-subset.json` preserves all 73 results and source stats. It selects crawler name/version/execution time/user agent, five crawl options, and the two long certificate-info table rows that reproduced the scalar-limit rejection. Other command, hostname, options and annexes were omitted. These are literal upstream observations, not newly executed crawler results or an authorized customer export. The subset has its own content hash, different from the original export.

The test checks format acceptance, full membership counts, bounded preview and annex withholding. It does not establish current site state, indexing, producer accuracy, complete crawl coverage, durable import storage or GSC joins.
